item.title: Cucumber & BDD Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Basics & Gherkin)

  1. What is Cucumber?
  2. Why do we use Cucumber?
  3. What is BDD (Behavior Driven Development)?
  4. What is a Feature File?
  5. What are the keywords used in a Feature File (Given, When, Then, And, But)?
  6. Explain the purpose of the Background keyword?
  7. What is a Scenario and a Scenario Outline?
  8. What is the purpose of Example tables in Cucumber?
  9. What are Tags in Cucumber and how are they used?
  10. Explain the Gherkin language?

Intermediate (Implementation & Configuration)

  1. What is a Step Definition file?
  2. What is a Runner Class in Cucumber?
  3. Explain Cucumber Options (@CucumberOptions)?
  4. What is the use of dryRun in Cucumber?
  5. What is monochrome in Cucumber?
  6. What are Hooks in Cucumber (Before and After)?
  7. Difference between Background and Hooks?
  8. What is the glue parameter in Cucumber?
  9. How do you handle Data Tables in Cucumber?
  10. How do you pass test data in a Scenario Outline?
  11. How do you generate reports in Cucumber?

Advanced (Framework & Integration)

  1. Explain the Cucumber framework architecture?
  2. How do you achieve parallel execution in Cucumber?
  3. How do you run failed test cases in Cucumber?
  4. How do you use Page Factory with Cucumber?
  5. What are listeners in the Cucumber framework?
  6. How do you re-use step definitions across different feature files?
  7. Difference between Cucumber and TestNG?
  8. Difference between BDD and TDD?
  9. How do you integrate Cucumber with Maven and Jenkins?
  10. Scenario: How would you write negative test cases in a feature file?

Questions with Answers

Beginner (Basics & Gherkin) - Answers

1. What is Cucumber?

Answer: Cucumber is an open-source test automation tool that supports Behavior Driven Development (BDD). It allows you to write test scenarios in plain, human-readable English (Gherkin).
